授業概要
This doctoral research seminar is designed to support PhD students in developing high-quality, original research in the field of Sustainable Urban Planning. The course provides a structured environment for students to conceptualize, develop, present, and refine their doctoral research through continuous scholarly engagement and peer discussion.
A central objective of the course is to guide students toward producing publishable research articles for reputable journals and conferences while simultaneously advancing their doctoral dissertation. The course emphasizes critical thinking, research design, methodological rigor, academic writing, and effective scholarly communication.
Research themes may include, but are not limited to, sustainable land use planning, land use efficiency, urban growth and development, environmental sustainability, social sustainability, urban resilience, spatial analysis, transportation and accessibility, climate adaptation, and related topics in sustainable urban planning.
The course is conducted primarily through weekly research meetings, student presentations, peer discussions, and individual consultations. Students are expected to present their research progress regularly, engage critically with the work of their peers, and incorporate feedback to strengthen both their publications and doctoral thesis.

全体の教育目標
Course Objectives
================
Upon successful completion of the course, students will be able to:
Develop a rigorous doctoral research framework in sustainable urban planning.
Conduct comprehensive literature reviews and identify research gaps.
Design and implement appropriate research methodologies.
Analyze and interpret research findings critically.
Produce manuscripts suitable for publication in peer-reviewed journals and conferences.
Effectively communicate research through oral presentations and academic discussions.
Progress systematically toward the completion of their doctoral dissertation.
個別の教育目標
Expected Outcomes
=================
By the end of the course, each student is expected to have:
A clearly defined doctoral research framework.
A comprehensive literature review.
An approved research methodology.
Publish international scientific journal papers with least one in Q1 journal and additional conference papers.
Demonstrable progress toward the completion of the doctoral thesis.
